name: screenrig
description: Pair screens, claim public browser setup codes, and operate ScreenRig content with the bundled CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Operate ScreenRig with its bundled CLI
interface.longDescription: Pair and manage ScreenRig screens, safely claim public homepage browser setup codes, and operate content through a packaged noninteractive CLI with automatic first-use enrollment.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $screenrig to pair the six-character code shown on my Player, claim a public browser setup code I provide, or manage my existing screens with machine-readable output.
